metadata.case_name: LEUNG CHOR HUNG v. WONG CHEUNG YUEN AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: metal worker / worked in the metal trade
plaintiff.occupation_after: metal worker (employed in Tsuen Wan on trial basis; also did casual carpentry)

injuries.description: partial amputation of his four fingers. The index and little fingers were amputated through the distal phalanx, whereas, the middle and ring fingers were amputated through the middle phalanx.
source: partial amputation of his four fingers. The index and little fingers were amputated through the distal phalanx, whereas, the middle and ring fingers were amputated through the middle phalanx.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified traumatic amputation of two or more fingers alone

manifestations.description: Cannot clench the fingers of his right hand
Cannot hold small objects in his right hand
Grip of 40 lbs in his right hand compared to a grip of 60 lbs in the left hand
Pain in the right hand persisted for 7 to 8 months
Occasional numbness and some pain in his fingers
Difficulty using chopsticks; now uses left hand for this purpose
Can only write a few characters with his right hand at a time
Difficulty in picking up and holding small objects with his right hand
Cannot lift heavy objects with his right hand on its own

treatments_received: Out-patient follow up at orthopaedic specialist clinic (13 visits)
Medication for pain for 7 to 8 months

losses.description: Partial amputation of four fingers of right hand causing permanent impairment and reduced grip

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Difficulty using chopsticks; difficulty picking up and holding small objects; can only write a few characters with right hand at a time; cannot lift heavy objects with right hand on its own
Difficulty obtaining employment because of the obvious injury to his right hand
